text: OpenAI has added a new model to its GPT six family. Released on September twenty-ninth, GPT six point one Sol is presented as approaching Astra's capability at a lower API cost. It is also rolling out in Work and Codex. For developers, the practical question is whether a less expensive model can handle their actual coding, computer-use, and professional tasks well enough. Documentation lists features and pricing, but supplier performance claims need independent testing. Teams still need to test their own workloads for errors, speed, and total cost. OpenAI's safety addendum also classifies this family at elevated cyber and biological or chemical capability levels, with safeguards attached. That is part of the release story, not a claim that every user gains those abilities. A model launch is a choice to evaluate, rather than proof that one system is best for everyone.
